protocols.description: The arrow follows the first branch's native message direction: canonical source→target maps to native [target,source]. Remove that shared learned adjacency entry before all graph-convolution layers. The transpose branch's reverse channel also changes; each native mixprop applies its own self-loop and normalization. This is a coupled shared-relation intervention, not an isolated directed message channel.
